findings.actual: US3, AC4, AC5 and T3 restrict the rule to cão and gato. F1 lists the general rule but no criterion tests other species.
findings.expected: The source rule 'Animais abaixo da idade mínima não podem ser agendados' (line 12) applies to any animal.
findings.impact: A non-dog, non-cat animal under 3 months could be scheduled and no criterion would fail.
findings.recommendation: Either add a criterion for the general rule or record an explicit decision in Q3 that other species are out of scope. Trace line 12 in full.
findings.why: The general rule is only partly traced. Other species are an open question (Q3) that the design did not resolve in the criteria.

findings.actual: AC8 fixes 'o registro não é concluído quando o lote não é informado', which is one of two alternatives in Q2. Q2 is open.
findings.expected: A proposed criterion should not fix an alternative of an open question.
findings.impact: Developers may implement blocking when the product owner prefers a pending-mark behaviour.
findings.recommendation: Keep AC8 explicitly marked as conditional on Q2, or present both alternatives as separate proposed criteria.
findings.why: The criterion pre-decides a choice the product owner has not made.

findings.actual: AC6 asserts that exactly 3 months is accepted. The source does not say whether the minimum is inclusive.
findings.expected: A boundary rule of 'mínima de 3 meses' states whether the boundary is inclusive only if the source does.
findings.impact: Off-by-one error in eligibility for animals of exactly 3 months.
findings.recommendation: Confirm Q5 before AC6 is treated as a requirement.
findings.why: Proposed boundary that depends on open Q5.

findings.actual: US5 adds 'no atendimento' and 'o sistema entregasse', and F3 adds 'sai do atendimento'. These are timing and mechanism assumptions.
findings.expected: The source says only that the tutor receives the receipt.
findings.impact: Scope could be built around an assumed timing that the owner does not want.
findings.recommendation: Mark timing as an assumption or defer it to Q1.

findings.actual: US5 is testable only for receipt. Content and channel are undefined until Q1.
findings.expected: A story's testable criteria should verify its want.
findings.impact: The story could be accepted without verifying the delivered content.
findings.recommendation: Keep US5 blocked on Q1 or split receipt from content once Q1 is answered.
findings.why: Testability depends on an open question.

findings.actual: T5's first activity is 'Definir conteúdo e canal de entrega' (decision, Q1). T5 is marked draft without a block.
findings.impact: The task may be picked up before Q1 is answered.
findings.recommendation: Record T5 as blocked by Q1 and move the decision out of the activities.
findings.why: A decision is not implementation work.

findings.actual: F2 and US4 overlap; F3 and US5 overlap; US4 and T4 have identical titles.
findings.expected: Each feature or story should carry distinct content.
findings.impact: Duplicate entries increase review load and may create double counting.
findings.recommendation: Collapse F2 or F3 into the child story, or give the feature a distinct capability statement.
findings.why: Sizing signal: a feature whose only child restates it.

findings.actual: Page 3 of prd.pdf has no text layer and could not be rendered by the reviewer. The design records it as Q4, which is correct. The reviewer could not verify page 3 content.
findings.expected: Every readable source obligation is traced; unreadable content is flagged as blocked.
findings.impact: Requirements on page 3 are unknown and may change the backlog.
findings.recommendation: Provide a legible copy of page 3 and rerun the review. Keep Q4 open until then.
findings.why: Source completeness cannot be confirmed for page 3.
